European Fire Insect quest: identify the catch

Start by comparing the target with European Firebug, the red-and-black insect recorded in the Residential Area at Bug Catching Level 1. Search for that exact name in the database below. A similarly red insect, Fire-Colored Beetle, has its own entry and habitat.

  1. Read the task name and compare its icon with the Collection entry.
  2. For European Firebug, search around home plots and the residential rocks. Current community data lists all four time periods and sunny, rainy or rainbow weather.
  3. Use your bug-catching tool, then check the name of the insect you caught.
  4. Reopen the active task and check its counter before repeating the route.

If the counter stays unchanged, keep a screenshot of the task, insect name and catch result. Player discussions mix residential Firebug advice with Onsen beetle advice, so the English task wording alone cannot establish that every version uses the same target. Compare Fire-Colored Beetle’s separate conditions if the icon differs.

Flower crossbreeding star-pairing chart

Use this community-documented chart to choose parent star tiers within the same flower species. The ranges are possible tiers, not guaranteed outcomes or fixed parent-color recipes.

CHART_ROWS
ParentsPossible seed tierUse

Choose parents with equal stars or a one-star difference. The documented rules exclude gaps of two or more stars and list five-star flowers as the endpoint. Check your Gardening Collection to translate a target color into its species-specific star tier, then choose a compatible pair from the table.

For example, start with two one-star parents for a possible two-star seed. Grow a new two-star flower and use the 2+2 pairing for a possible three-star result. Each attempt can remain at the current tier. Water mature flowers and inspect the next server-day result before changing the bed.

Checked November 10, 2026 against Heartodex’s community star rules ↗. Flower forms and pairings use the same local dataset. Other guides publish conflicting color formulas, so a complete species-by-species color matrix remains unverified.

Roaming Oak location today: check the server date

An exact Roaming Oak coordinate for November 10, 2026 has not been verified here. Use a daily report that matches your server’s current date, then confirm its landmark in game before travelling across the map.

  1. Check your in-game server date and whether its daily reset has passed.
  2. Read a dated report or forecast and compare the house-plot number with your own map.
  3. If Oak-Oak is absent from the reported plot, check the other home plots and the original Spirit-Oak Pine Forest encounter area.
  4. Keep the current day’s observation separate from yesterday’s report.

Community reports describe a home-plot route and the forest fallback. A daily forecast can help, but cached search results may still label November 9 as “today” while your server is on November 10. Open the source and read its actual date.
